title: Are You Still Married
author: Naheed Akhtar
text:
Convincingly seemed,
An easy possibility to reply,
The query by a lady chum, not more
Than half a cycle of 12 months

Whilst, its intimacy extended
With the ghosts inside the core and depth;
A concord of conflict corroborated
Betwix` the then unconcerned mood
And later fathomed sensitivity

These differences accounted to blast
An irreplaceable incomprehension
Of the layers hid in that suspicion;

Do the peripheral waves or
The inherent ease of expression,
Invited a cohort into such compulsion
To give birth within
A paranoia about my own being
